description: Business time elapsed (SLA clock) — How much business time has passed between two moments: counts only working hours on working days in any IANA time zone, skips weekends and US federal holidays (observed dates), subtracts pauses (waiting-on-customer), and with target_hours reports SLA used %, remaining time, ON TRACK / AT RISK / BREACHED and the exact due or breach time. Params: start (required; local ISO in tz, or with Z/offset, or unix), end (default now), tz (default America/New_York), hours (09:00-17:00 or 24h), days (mon-fri, mon,wed,fri, all), holidays (us|none), exclude (extra closed dates YYYY-MM-DD,...), pauses (start~end,...), target_hours or target_minutes. Per-day breakdown included. Example: /v1/time/business-elapsed?start=2026-11-25T16:00&end=2026-12-01T09:30&tz=America/Chicago&target_hours=8 Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: time_business_elapsed
